svg.title: Basement ceiling planning: candidate openings
svg.desc: Measured grid-map floor footprints in X Z top view, with two unchosen four by four metre opening candidates. No construction approved.

g.text: Actual floor-cell footprints · world X/Z metres · openings are proposals, not holes
Grey: B1 floor · Blue: B2 floor at Y=7 · Purple: preserved Hidden · Red crosses: reproduced traps
A: near existing crates — opening X16–20, Z0–4; B: separate central route — X24–28, Z12–16
Lam + Quan choose one before cutting. Landing/retry outlines require later physical validation.
